description: Withdraw a digital human **created through AI**, only within 24 hours and only if nobody has chatted with it yet; when eligible it is deleted and the 2 creation badges are refunded. Digital humans you created in the app are not deleted here — use "My Digital Humans" in the app. On deletion it disappears from the map and its conversation history is cleared.

id.description: Id of the digital human to withdraw (from create_digital_human or my_digital_humans)

name: delete_digital_human
title: Delete an AI-created Digital Human
